crossRefs.note: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded…
Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

translations.web: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
translations.bsb: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
translations.kjv: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
translations.asv: Stir up thyself, and awake to the justice due unto me, Even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
